mood_board: The cinematic identity of Crafters Market is raw, precise, and emotionally charged. We are replacing flat SaaS gradients with 'Industrial Luxury' — deep charcoal environments pierced by molten copper light, amber sparks, and technical blueprint grids. Every section should feel like stepping into a premium workshop, focusing on the machinery, raw textures, and the hands that build.

typography.strategy: Retain existing font stack. Focus on dramatic scale contrast. H1s should be tight and massive (tracking-tighter), while subheadings should be spaced and technical (tracking-widest).

classes.hero_headline: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white drop-shadow-md
classes.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-orange-500 uppercase

reusable_elements.copper_glow_utility: absolute pointer-events-none rounded-full blur-[100px] opacity-40 bg-amber-600/30
reusable_elements.button_primary: bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(249,115,22,0.5)]

motion_specs.guardrails: All framer-motion animations must include `viewport={{ once: true }}` and respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Use CSS media queries or framer-motion's useReducedMotion hook to disable video autoplay, particle motion, and intense parallax on mobile devices and for users who prefer reduced motion.

effects.drift: Slow, subtle Y-axis translations (e.g., y: [0, -10, 0]) over 10-15s for background elements. Must pause if reduced motion.
effects.fade_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
effects.sparks: Particle effect using framer-motion for subtle rising glowing dots, fading out at the top. Disable entirely on reduced motion and mobile cellular.

sections.name: Hero
sections.composition: Layer 1: Deep black bg. Layer 2: Workshop photo (opacity 30-40%). Layer 3: Blueprint texture overlay (mix-blend-overlay or screen, opacity 20%). Layer 4: Ambient copper glowing orb (blur-3xl). Layer 5: Content layer.

copy.headline: Raw Materials. Radical Craft.
copy.subheading: The premier marketplace for CNC, plasma, and custom fabrication. Commission real makers in real workshops.

sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a multi-layered cinematic hero. Do NOT use an opaque blanket overlay. Blend the AI blueprint texture with the workshop photo. Add a framer-motion glowing orb in the background that slowly drifts. Ensure text contrast is accessible. MUST include data-testid='hero-cta-explore' and data-testid='hero-cta-join'.

sections.name: FeaturedBuildsRail
sections.design_concept: Framed gallery prints. Replace standard border-radius with sharp corners or 2px micro-rounding. Add a subtle inner border (white/10). On hover, scale image inside overflow-hidden, and make 'Commission' CTA glow.
sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor card visuals. Add `.cinematic-frame` class to cards. The '✦ EXAMPLE' pill should use amber-500 bg with black text for intense contrast. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testids.

sections.name: AiDiscoverySearch
sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT break layout or remove any testids. Retain all functionality. Update background to `bg-[#0a0a0a]`. Change input borders to `border-white/10 focus:border-orange-500`. Enhance placeholder chips to align with the new Forge palette.

sections.name: CinematicMomentsStrip
sections.design_concept: A low-profile horizontal strip of 3 short looping videos that bring the workshop to life. Placed immediately after the Featured Builds section.
sections.layout: Grid of 3 panels (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`). Use `.cinematic-frame` for each video container. Add section header with 'Watch on /clips →' CTA.
sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Build this new section in the homepage. Video must use `<video muted autoplay playsinline loop>`. For performance/mobile, ensure videos are lazy-loaded and do not auto-play on reduced-data modes if detectable, or simply hide them on small viewports if performance dictates. Add data-testids to the section and CTA.

sections.name: MeetTheMakers
sections.design_concept: Real people in real workshops. Portraits are treated with a grayscale/duotone filter that blooms into full color upon card hover. Hard, industrial container borders.
sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor Maker cards with `.cinematic-frame`. Implement CSS grayscale transition on hover. Stack the portrait image cleanly. Add a subtle amber `.copper_glow_utility` behind the card on hover. Add data-testids for Maker profile links.

sections.name: WhyWeExist
sections.design_concept: The emotional anchor. Features oversized, tightly tracked typography. A massive copper glow and blueprint texture reveal themselves behind the text as the user scrolls.
sections.instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to increase the opacity and scale of a background copper glow as the component enters the viewport. Typography should be `text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl` with `tracking-tighter`. Respect reduced-motion (fallback to static glow).

implementation_priority: 1. Hero (Highest ROI, sets the cinematic mood)
